## Change summary

## Reliability evidence

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change and a relevant negative case.
- [ ] `ruff format --check`, `ruff check`, and `mypy` pass.
- [ ] Deterministic evidence was regenerated when schemas, scoring, or tasks changed.
- [ ] Baseline changes are explained rather than accepted only to make CI green.
- [ ] No secrets, production traces, or customer data are included.
